acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Rob and Reyna Mathis go house hunting with their family in Muskegon, Michigan. What they find in a police officer’s home prompts an upsetting debate.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Rob and Reyna weigh whether or not they should go public with what they’ve seen.
acts.title: The Decision

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: The response to Rob and Reyna’s Facebook post is loud and immediate. This officer has a past and people have thoughts about him in the town he works, Muskegon, Michigan.
acts.title: It Begins

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Muskegon’s City Manager and Chief of Police have to figure out what to do about their employee who’s now in the spotlight.
acts.title: The People in Charge

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: People in Muskegon show up at a community meeting to talk about their run-ins with this particular police officer. The reviews are not good.
acts.title: We Know That Guy

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: An example of how this officer could be on the job. One man's life was upended when the officer showed up at his mom’s birthday party over a noise complaint.
acts.title: Officer Anderson On the Job

acts.label: Act Six
acts.desc: Rob and Reyna Mathis deal with the scary fallout of their choice to name the officer.
acts.title: Things Get Ugly

acts.label: Act Seven
acts.desc: The official investigation by the city of Muskegon into the officer’s past gets underway– and we have a transcript of what went down! Finally we hear the officer – and his wife – explain themselves.
acts.title: The Investigation
